parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorEntryId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry to delete.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the IPv6 Translation Service.

> If you do not specify the **Ipv6TranslatorEntryId** parameter, all mapping entries of the specified instance are deleted.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query region IDs.
